evals.prompt: Create a PRD.json for adding password reset to this repository. Inspect the project structure first and create dependency-aware ralphy tasks. Put independent implementation tasks in the same parallel_group only if they can safely run concurrently.
evals.expected_output: Creates PRD.json with unique task titles, completed=false, 2-space JSON formatting, dependency-aware parallel_group values, and no invented project-specific files unless supported by repository inspection.

evals.prompt: There is already a PRD.json with completed and pending tasks. Add tasks for an admin dashboard without changing existing completed values or removing existing tasks. Use parallel_group values so API/schema work can run before UI wiring.
evals.expected_output: Reads and preserves existing PRD.json tasks, appends dashboard tasks with unique titles, keeps existing completed flags unchanged, and assigns later parallel_group values for dependent UI wiring.

evals.prompt: Mark login as done in PRD.json. If more than one task title contains login, do not guess. Ask me which matching task should be updated.
evals.expected_output: Updates completed=true only when exactly one task matches login; if multiple tasks match, asks for clarification and does not modify the file.

evals.prompt: Split this work into ralphy tasks in PRD.json: add export filters, add CSV export endpoint, add frontend export button, update docs, and add tests. Make sure dependent tasks do not share the same parallel_group.
evals.expected_output: Creates or updates PRD.json with independent tasks grouped safely, dependent frontend/tests/docs tasks placed after prerequisite implementation groups, unique titles, and valid JSON.

evals.prompt: We are in a monorepo and I did not specify where PRD.json belongs. Prepare ralphy tasks for billing reports, but ask me for the target PRD path instead of silently writing to the repo root.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes ambiguous target path in a monorepo, asks for the intended PRD.json location, and does not create or modify a root PRD.json without confirmation.

evals.prompt: Write a normal product requirements document for a billing dashboard with goals, users, scope, and acceptance criteria. This is not for ralphy-cli and I do not want PRD.json.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is an ordinary product requirements document request, not a ralphy-cli PRD.json task, and does not create or modify PRD.json.

evals.prompt: Create a generic JSON todo list for the next frontend sprint, but do not use ralphy-cli or PRD.json.
evals.expected_output: Does not treat a generic JSON todo list as a ralphy PRD task, avoids the PRD.json workflow, and either answers normally or asks whether ralphy/PRD.json is intended before editing files.
